**How to falsify it:** Identification of distinct causal genes for each disease or evidence that ABCB6 mutations in one disease lead to gain-of-function effects while the other requires loss-of-function. _(variant: rs34607749)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of ABCB6 in these pigmentary disorders could lead to unified therapeutic strategies targeting the porphyrin biosynthesis pathway for both conditions.
